author: blu
body: Proves Volcanic Eruption: "Destroy X target lands." compiles to EruptX and is cast through the X-spell path -- the fixed cost is paid first, then cast-eruption pours all remaining mana into X and destroys that many of the opponent's lands. Here the caster has 2 mana left over and the opponent controls three lands, so two are destroyed and one survives. The damage-per-Mountain rider is not modelled; the land denial is the effect kept.
